definitions.explanation: A plainclothes police officer who investigates crimes.
Relating to criminal law or cases.

examples.japanese: {刑事|けいじ}が{事件|じけん}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: A detective is investigating the case.

examples.japanese: {刑事|けいじ}{事件|じけん}として{扱|あつか}われた。
examples.english: It was handled as a criminal case.

examples.japanese: あの{刑事|けいじ}ドラマは{人気|にんき}がある。
{彼|かれ}は{刑事|けいじ}{責任|せきにん}を{問|と}われた。{裁判|さいばん}は{来月|らいげつ}{始|はじ}まる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: He was held criminally liable. The trial is scheduled to begin next month.

notes:
{刑事|けいじ} has two main uses.

AS 'DETECTIVE':
- Refers to plainclothes police officers
- Often featured in crime dramas ({刑事|けいじ}ドラマ)

AS 'CRIMINAL' (prefix/adjective):
- {刑事|けいじ}{事件|じけん} (criminal case)
- {刑事|けいじ}{裁判|さいばん} (criminal trial)
- {刑事|けいじ}{責任|せきにん} (criminal liability)
- {刑事|けいじ}{罰|ばつ} (criminal punishment)

CONTRAST:
- {刑事|けいじ} (criminal) ↔ {民事|みんじ} (civil)
- {刑事|けいじ}{裁判|さいばん} (criminal trial) ↔ {民事|みんじ}{裁判|さいばん} (civil trial)
